label: Cogito selected capacity formula transport and omission controls
paraphrase: At one selected world, an explicit pointwise equivalence between an old thin power profile and possession of a specified intellectual-effect capacity preserves exactly IntellectualExerciserHasPowerAt and PowerRequiresConcreteAt. Other worlds and respects are unrestricted. A one-bearer, one-world, one-episode Boolean-respect model has an actual attributed intellectual exercise and another capacity, but no selected intellectual capacity or concrete bearer: all five remaining Cogito premises hold when exercise-to-selected-capacity is omitted. The same model satisfies exercise-to-old-power and selected-capacity-to-concreteness while the mapping and the concrete-existence conclusion fail. These controls expose invalid omission and mixed-profile composition; they supply no evidence against actual capacity or its metaphysical bridges.
